svg.title: Cut-away of a 10 by 10 by 10 cost cube with a bidirectional A* path
svg.desc: Cells are colored by cost from dark purple (cheap) to yellow (expensive). Bright cells were expanded by the search, dim cells were never touched. The white line is the optimal path.
svg.text: Bidirectional A* on a 10×10×10 cost cube, 26 moves
bright cells were expanded · dim cells never touched · line is the optimal path
